messages:
deploybot: PRE-RELEASE CHECK FAILED — env/secret path parity issues detected for release `release/2026-03-21`
- staging env secret: `API_KEY` (uppercase) present
- prod env secret: `Api_Key` (mixed case) present
- SSM param path: staging `/services/model/api/keys` vs prod `/services/model/api/keys/v2`
- TLS cert subject CN mismatch between canary and prod webhook endpoint

emma: wow. mixed-case var names again? who changed the prod secret? :facepalm:

deploybot: Prod secret last updated by `ops-bot` at 3742998000, annotated with commit `infra/ssm-normalize`. No corresponding entry in the release bundle diff.

fred: if we let this go to prod some services will read empty API_KEY env and fail auth. Suggest we hold promotion and pin canary to previous image tag `model-api:v2026-03-18`.

gwen: +1 to pin. Also TLS CN mismatch — our webhook client validates CN strictly (by design). If cert rotated with different CN, callbacks will 403. Need to coordinate cert rotation with release window.

emma: can we hotpatch prod secret name to include both keys for compatibility (copy `Api_Key` -> `API_KEY`)? Risky but fast. Thoughts?

harry: risky if rotation happens concurrently. Better: pin canary and run a controlled short maintenance: create API_KEY from existing Api_Key via SSM copy, deploy, then monitor. Do not do blind writes to prod without approval.

fred: plan proposal: (1) hold promotion, set tag `release:hold:env-ssm-cn-parity` (2) patch canary to `model-api:v2026-03-18` to avoid rolling forward incompatible bundle (3) schedule a 10m maintenance window tomorrow 09:30 UTC to create API_KEY and reconcile SSM paths and cert CN, with rollback steps documented. Anyone object? :thumbsup:

emma: agree. I'll open a short PR to add a compatibility shim to the helm chart that reads both names for a grace period. That reduces risk of dual reads during migration. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/helm-charts/pull/452

gwen: I'll contact infra to confirm the cert CN and ask for cert backout if needed.

deploybot: Suggested kubectl commands to pin canary image:
```bash
kubectl -n canary patch deployment model-api-canary \n  --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/image","value":"gcr.io/redwood/model-api:v2026-03-18"}]'
# restart pods to pick up image
kubectl -n canary rollout restart deploy/model-api-canary
```

harry: I'll schedule the maintenance window and add the runbook checklist. ETA 20m for calendar invite.

emma: running quick grep across services for exact env var case sensitivity. Found 4 services that reference `API_KEY` exact, 2 referencing `Api_Key`. I'll paste results after audit.

fred: tagging release ticket: "Blocked — env var casing + SSM path + TLS CN parity" and adding references to PR and runbook.

deploybot: ACTION: Promotion blocked. Auto-promotion disabled until manual approval. Reason: env-secret-name and ssm-path drift, TLS certificate CN mismatch.

gwen: thanks. will follow up with infra and cert team.

emma: adding grep output here:
```
services/auth-service: config/env.yaml -> API_KEY
services/webhook-worker: config/env.yaml -> API_KEY (strict CN check)
services/metrics-collector: env var from secret -> Api_Key
services/model-ingest: env var from ssm -> /services/model/api/keys/v2
```

harry: good catch. we should be safe to pin and then perform the small compatibility backfill. I'll send the invite now.

fred: perfect. locking the release until post-migration verification.
